keybind.keybind: The key that the module will respond to.
keybind.bind-type:
Bind type:
  Toggle — module toggles on/off after pressing the key.
  Hold — module is active while the key is held.
  HoldReversed — module is inactive while the key is held.

aura: Automatically attacks players and entities in range.
aura.target-range: The distance at which the aura can see the target.
aura.attack-range: Maximum attack distance of the aura.
aura.fov:
Aura vision range in degrees.
If you don't look at the target within these
 degrees, the aura won't see it.
aura.criticals-mode:
Critical attack mode:
 None — aura will not attack with crits.
 Only — aura will attack only with crits.
 Smart — aura will attack with crits if jump is held.
aura.delay-mode:
Attack delay mode:
 Cooldown — delay is calculated based on the cooldown of the item in hand.
 Timer — delay is calculated based on a timer.
aura.sprint-reset: Stops sprinting before hitting to allow critical hits.

rotation-category.smart-rotate: Only starts rotation if the player is not looking at the target.
rotation-category.angle-step: Maximum step in degrees that the rotation can turn per tick.
rotation-category.move-fix: Adjusts player movement to match rotation, making movements legitimate.

targets-category.priority:
Target priority mode:
 Distance — aura selects the closest target.
 HealthMax — aura selects the target with the most health.
 HealthMin — aura selects the target with the least health.
targets-category.enemy-priority: Among all targets, the aura will always prioritize those added as enemies.
targets-category.lock-target: The first selected target will be locked as long as it is visible to the aura.

pause-if-category.eating: Pause aura if the player is eating.
pause-if-category.not-weapon-in-hand: Pause aura if no weapon is in hand.

auto-armor: Automatically equip the best armor in your inventory.

score-category: Score settings for specific armor attributes.
score-category.armor: Number of score per unit of armor.
score-category.armor-toughness: Number of score per unit of armor toughness.
score-category.knockback-resistance:
Number of score per unit of
knockback resistance.

auto-armor.anti-binding-curse: Prevents the equipping of any armor with the 'Binding curse' enchantment.
auto-armor.keep-elytra: Prevents the equipping of the chestplate if elytra are equipped.

auto-offhand: Automatically takes need item into offhand.
auto-offhand.replace-other: Allow replacing of other items in the offhand.

auto-2fa: Automatically sends the login with 2fa command.
auto-2fa.auto-disable: Disabling the module after sending the command.

auto-auth.auto-disable: Disabling the module after sending the command.

auto-sign.back-side: Write the text on the back of the sign.

elytra-swap: Instantly puts on or takes off elytra.

fast-use: Allows faster use of certain items.

free-camera: Detaches the camera from the player, allowing free flight.
free-camera.player-move-sync: Adds the player's speed to the camera speed so the camera follows the player.
free-camera.rotate: Rotate towards the current camera raycast.

inventory-tweaks.shift-drag:
Instant movement of items when hovering
 over a slot while holding down LMB and shift.
inventory-tweaks.group-move:
Instant movement all similar items with
 clicked item when pressing LMB, shift and ctrl.
inventory-tweaks.auto-tool:
When starting to break a block, take
 the best item for it.
 (Supports GuiMove with Grim mode)
inventory-tweaks.ore-priority:
Pickaxe enchantment priority when mining ore.
 None — none.
 Fortune — luck.
 SilkTouch — silk touch.
inventory-tweaks.safe-ender-chests:
When breaking an ender chest, a pickaxe
 with the 'Silk Touch' enchantment will be selected.
inventory-tweaks.hotbar-replenish: Automatic replenish of items in the hotbar from the inventory.
inventory-tweaks.min-items:
The minimum number of items that can be
 stored in a stack without replenish it.
inventory-tweaks.inventory-cleaner: Automatic throwing of various trash from inventory.
inventory-tweaks.trash: Items that will be considered as trash.
inventory-tweaks.throw-delay: Delay in milliseconds between throwing items.

multi-task: Allows you to use items from both hands at the same time.
multi-task.attacking:
Ability to attack entities while using the item.
§7(for example, when using a shield)

xcarry: Allows storing four extra stacks of items in the crafting grid.

blink: Delays packets on the client side to teleport instantly on the server side.
blink.reset: Sends previously delayed packets after a certain time.

elytra-boost: Accelerates you while flying with elytra.
elytra-boost.start-boost-pitch:
Starting pitch for boost.
 If you look above this value, you will not accelerate.
elytra-boost.pause-if-blink: Pause boost if you are in blink.

elytra-recast: Fast elytra flight by bouncing off the ground.
elytra-recast.blink: Delay packets on the client side before bouncing off the ground.
elytra-recast.blink-ticks: How many ticks after bouncing packets will still be delayed.
elytra-recast.change-pitch: Changes the player's vertical look to a fixed value.

freeze: Allows you to hover in mid-air for some time.
freeze.reset: Sends previously delayed packets after a certain time.

gui-move: Allows moving while inventory or other GUI is open.

safe-walk:
Automatically sneaks at block edges to prevent falling.
§eMay work poorly with slabs or other non-standard sized blocks.

timer: Changes the tick speed on the client side.

ambience: Changes the visual appearance of the world.

world-time-category.world-time:
World time mode.
  Day — day.
  Night — night.
  Morning — morning.
  Sunset — sunset.
  Custom — custom time.
  Spin — time changes at a certain speed.

arrows: Renders arrows pointing to player locations.
arrows.radius: Radius of the circle on which arrows are displayed.
arrows.3d: Tilts the arrow circle depending on your vertical look.
arrows.max-angle: Maximum tilt angle of the arrow circle.
arrows.teams-color:
Team color display mode:
  None — arrows will not show team colors.
  YourTeam — arrows will only show your team's color.
  AllTeams — arrows will show all teams' colors.

block-outline: Replaces the highlighted block outline with a custom one.
block-outline.depth-test:
Respect depth when rendering.
 §eHighlighting may flicker if rendered far from the camera.

breadcrumbs: Renders a line where you have been before.
breadcrumbs.max-vertices:
Maximum number of vertices in the line.
 (proportional to the maximum number of stored player positions).

container-esp.bright-blend: Color blending where overlapping boxes become brighter.

full-bright.mode:
Mode:
  Gamma — changes the gamma. You can also
   set any color.
  Potion — applies night vision to the player.
  BlockLight — changes the light level of blocks.

hand-view: Changes the position, rotation, and size of hands.
hand-view.custom-fov: Custom field of view for hands.

nametags: Replaces the rendering of player nametags with a custom one.
nametags.height: Height of nametag rendering relative to the highest point of the hitbox.
nametags.team-color: Recolor the player's name to their team color.

no-render: Allows disabling the rendering of certain elements.

world-category.texture-rotation: Disable block rotation changes (grass, stone, etc.).

player-esp.gradient: Display box sides as a gradient.

tooltips: When hovering over a slot containing a shulker box, shows its contents.

tracers: Renders lines from the center of the screen to various entities.

xray: Allows you rendering only necessary blocks.

zoom.zoom-step: Zoom step when scrolling the mouse wheel.
